title: Neuron-Level Interpretability and Robustness in LLMs (SYNAPSE)
description: Auditing framework for neuron-level interpretability and robustness of Transformer-based classifiers. Includes probe-based neuron ranking, global and per-class neuron silencing, random-neuron controls, attribution-method agreement (conductance and activation x gradient), attribution-guided bit-flip, and output/weight-space perturbations, evaluated on malware system-call detection and on the GoEmotions emotion-classification task. Code accompanying the SYNAPSE paper.
